scripts.test:api:callable: pnpm run package:api && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-taskify --only auth,functions,firestore "pnpm --filter @taskify/api exec vitest run --config ../../infrastructure/firebase/vitest.callable.config.mts"
scripts.test:firestore:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project taskify-local --only firestore "pnpm --filter @taskify/api exec vitest run --config ../../infrastructure/firebase/vitest.rules.config.mts"
scripts.test:firestore:queries: firebase emulators:exec --project taskify-local --only firestore "pnpm --filter @taskify/api exec vitest run --config ../../infrastructure/firebase/vitest.queries.config.mts"
